coverage_notes: Read the toy design end to end.

evidence.quoted: does not specify how batches are assigned

findings.failure_mode: Any reported arm difference is confounded with whatever process actually placed batches into arms.
findings.statement: The design names two arms but never states how a batch is assigned to one, so no contrast between arms identifies a causal effect.
findings.title: No assignment mechanism is specified
findings.what_would_refute: A design revision that states a randomisation procedure and its seed source.
